design.user_request: 只使用 file_creator 工具，不要执行任何 shell 命令。在工作目录创建两个文件：C:\Users\tortl\AppData\Local\Temp\pytest-of-tortl\pytest-200\verify_p1_workdir0\a.txt 内容 hello，C:\Users\tortl\AppData\Local\Temp\pytest-of-tortl\pytest-200\verify_p1_workdir0\b.txt 内容 world

interactions: file_creator tool receives file creation requests with paths and content
file_creator tool validates relative paths within workspace root
file_creator tool creates nested directory structure if not exists
file_creator tool writes content to a.txt and b.txt
file system stores created files persistently

required_tools.limitations: relative paths must be resolved from workspace root; nested directory creation depends on tool implementation
required_tools.impact: critical - primary tool for completing the task

risks: path resolution accuracy for deeply nested directories
potential permission issues if target directory is not writable
race conditions if multiple processes attempt simultaneous file creation in same directory
file overwrite behavior if files already exist at target paths
